column13: Willie Heston concluded his legendary collegiate career with dominant off-tackle power rushes behind All-American Tom Hammond. The season reached its climax in the Championship Decider, where Fielding Yost's Michigan squad secured national championship honors over Amos Alonzo Stagg's Chicago.
